subject.title: bug(agents): nodes tool describe action fails with 'node required' due to schema/implementation mismatch

question: Should omitted-node `nodes` `describe` calls resolve through the existing default-node picker, return list-style discovery data, or remain invalid with a stricter model-facing schema?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the issue discussion and the linked PR choose different model-facing behavior for multi-node discovery, so automation should not decide the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Confirm default-node describe
options.body: Treat omitted-node `describe` as a read-only default-node lookup, then require focused regression coverage and after-fix proof before merge.

options.title: Use discovery output
options.body: Replace the linked PR shape with behavior that returns node-list style discovery data when `node` is omitted, avoiding implicit target selection in multi-node setups.

options.title: Require explicit node
options.body: Keep `describe` target-specific and update the model-facing schema or prompt contract so `node` is required for this action.

recommendation.title: Confirm default-node describe
recommendation.body: Treat omitted-node `describe` as a read-only default-node lookup, then require focused regression coverage and after-fix proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history across the flattened `nodes` tool schema and default-node resolver path involved in this decision.
